text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...All right!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Honed to perfection, the stage of a lifetime arrives—
the day of the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—With Agnes Tachyon absent,
today's Nihon Derby is about to get underway.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, the spotlight is definitely on Jungle Pocket today!
All eyes are on her performance—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (...Pokke-chan really stands out.)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (Brings back memories. It was like this back when I had just enrolled, too.)

text_block_list.name: Past Pokke
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Dantsu Flame, right?
Mind being my partner for the next joint training?

text_block_list.name: Past Dantsu
text_block_list.text: Huh!? M-Me?

text_block_list.name: Past Pokke
text_block_list.text:
"Can't catch an opponent.
Don't know if they're chickening out or what."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"A rough-and-tumble former team leader
who ran wild in freestyle races."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Pokke-chan was so kind, funny, and cool
that all those labels peeled away in an instant.
Above all—

text_block_list.name: Past Pokke
text_block_list.text: ORA AAAAAAAAH!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Kicking up the dirt and charging across the turf with everything you had—
that sight instantly captivated everyone's gaze, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: When you say "genius", Agnes Tachyon comes to mind, but—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Jungle Pocket is like a diamond in the rough, ya know?!
I just really feel a whole lotta potential in her~!

text_block_list.name: Past Dantsu
text_block_list.text:
...
Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: We're classmates, friends, and from the same generation, but...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
To me, you've always, always been
the leading star I look up to.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (...Still, even so...)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ――I want to win, too!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I won't lose, and I won't back down...!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: —Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
If anything, I'm regretting
that I took notice of you a bit too late.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Still, the "strongest" ain't you.
—And it ain't Tachyon either.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: It's me!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Now, who will stand at the pinnacle of this generation?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: The second leg of the early summer Classics, the Japan Derby, is officially underway!
